patch_description: This version combines differential-evolution global exploration and epigraph SLSQP polishing from the current implementation with the barycentric, active-constraint-guided annealing strategy from the crossover program. The hybrid search first finds a broad high-quality configuration, then performs efficient incremental local maximin refinement in simplex coordinates before a final constrained epigraph polish. All randomness is deterministic, points remain inside the equilateral triangle, and a dependency-free refinement path is retained if SciPy is unavailable.
